_note: Real guest reviews, copied from the public LekkeSlaap and Booking.com listings on 2026-10-28. Text is the guest's own, shortened to whole sentences where a review was long; nothing is invented. 'translated' means the guest wrote in Afrikaans and the platform shows an English translation. Run `npm run build:reviews` after editing.
